children: IPG Photonics entered into a Share Purchase Agreement to acquire 100% of Lumibird Medical for €300 million on a cash-free, debt-free basis, with up to €50 million in additional earn-out tied to 2026 and 2027 performance. The purchase price will be paid in cash at closing, funded from cash on hand, and is subject to customary adjustments. Closing is contingent on French foreign investment clearance and an AMF waiver, and is expected in Q4 2026. The company has secured warranty and indemnity insurance, with limited seller liability except for fundamental warranties and in cases of fraud or willful misconduct.
